description: GTA 6's first week in ten numbers, every one checked in at least two sources, no story spoilers: $3.79 billion (and the catch), $79.99 (the cheapest GTA ever after inflation), 99 on Metacritic, 80 hours, 30 FPS (even on PS5 Pro), 3.3 million Twitch viewers, 309 million trailer views, 4 secrets players found, 7 fixes in the first patch notes and 8 Game Awards nominations. Which number surprised you most?

segments.headline: GTA 6 IN 10 NUMBERS
segments.text: One week after launch, here's GTA 6 in ten numbers. Every one checked in at least two sources, and what each one actually tells us.

segments.headline: NUMBER 1
segments.text: Number one: three point seven nine billion dollars. That's what Take-Two reported for pre-orders plus the first day.

segments.headline: VS GTA 5
segments.text: GTA 5's first day, back in 2013, was eight hundred million. So on paper, GTA 6 did almost five times that.

segments.headline: THE CATCH
segments.text: The catch: GTA 6's number includes months of pre-orders, and it costs eighty dollars, not sixty. It's not a clean comparison.

chart.ticker: GTA 5: one day at $60 · GTA 6: pre-orders + day one at $80-$100

segments.headline: OUTSIDE ESTIMATE
segments.text: But even Sensor Tower's outside estimate, one point eight four billion by release day, is more than double GTA 5. Either way, it's the biggest launch Rockstar has ever had.

segments.headline: NUMBER 2
segments.text: Number two: seventy nine dollars and ninety nine cents. That's the standard price. Ultimate costs twenty more.

segments.headline: AFTER INFLATION
segments.text: Adjust for inflation, though, and it's the cheapest GTA ever. GTA 3 and GTA 4 cost about ninety four dollars in today's money.

chart.note: Launch price in Oct 2026 dollars (BLS CPI-U)

segments.headline: THE SURPRISE
segments.text: The surprise: Take-Two says more people pre-ordered the hundred-dollar Ultimate edition than the standard one. And its boss says no holiday discount. Zelnick's explanation: the most avid fans are the ones who pre-order first, and they buy everything.

segments.headline: NUMBER 3
segments.text: Number three: ninety nine on Metacritic. Only one other game ever got that: Zelda, Ocarina of Time.

segments.headline: PERFECT TENS
segments.text: Of a hundred forty seven critic reviews on PS5, a hundred eighteen were perfect scores, as of launch week. That's not one hyped outlet. That's eight in ten critics giving it a perfect score.

segments.headline: EVERY GTA RANKED
segments.text: Against the whole series: GTA 6 and GTA 4 are S tier, GTA 3 and 5 are A tier, and Vice City and San Andreas land in B.

segments.headline: NUMBER 4
segments.text: Number four: eighty hours. Rockstar's own estimate for the story plus some side missions.

segments.headline: TWO AND A HALF GTA 5S
segments.text: Red Dead 2 takes about fifty one hours. GTA 5, about thirty two. That's two and a half GTA 5s.

chart.note: GTA 6: Rockstar's estimate; others: HowLongToBeat main story

segments.headline: 13 YEARS
segments.text: And it took thirteen years to get here. No other gap between GTAs was even six. Kids born the week GTA 5 came out are thirteen now.

segments.headline: NUMBER 5
segments.text: Number five: thirty frames per second. On PS5, GTA 5 runs at sixty. GTA 6 runs at thirty.

segments.headline: 60 VS 30
segments.text: That's half the frame rate of a game from 2013, on the same console. Rockstar chose a bigger, denser world over a smoother one.

segments.headline: NOT EVEN PRO
segments.text: Not even the PS5 Pro gets sixty. Rockstar told Kotaku its processor can't handle the simulation. The Pro gets ray-traced shadows and a sharper picture instead.

chart.ticker: sharper, not smoother · ray-traced shadows · 40 FPS ruled out

segments.headline: NUMBER 6
segments.text: Number six: three point three million. GTA 6's peak on Twitch.

segments.headline: TWITCH RECORD
segments.text: That beat League of Legends' record for a single game. Across Twitch, YouTube and Kick, the peak passed seven million. For a single-player game, that's unheard of.

chart.src: Streams Charts via Dot Esports · Insider Gaming · Wccftech

segments.headline: ISHOWSPEED
segments.text: And the three most-watched GTA 6 streams on YouTube all belong to IShowSpeed. His launch stream: sixty eight million views.

segments.headline: NUMBER 7
segments.text: Number seven: three hundred nine million. Views on GTA 6's first trailer, from 2023.

segments.headline: TRAILER 1 WINS
segments.text: It still beats trailer two and the launch trailer combined. The hype for that first look still beats everything Rockstar has shown since.

segments.headline: NUMBER 8
segments.text: Number eight: four. The secrets players found in the first days.

segments.headline: THE SECRETS
segments.text: A Paul Walker tribute car, a Bigfoot in the swamps, an NPC who knows he's in a simulation, and a literal Easter egg on top of a tower.

segments.headline: CUT
segments.text: And two things that didn't make it: darts and bowling. Rockstar North said even Rockstar doesn't have unlimited time.

segments.headline: NUMBER 9
segments.text: Number nine: seven. The fixes in the first patch notes Rockstar has published, for update three.

segments.headline: PATCH 1.002.002
segments.text: Crashes, autosaves, phone calls that wouldn't trigger, and a wanted level you couldn't lose. The first two updates came out with no notes at all.

segments.headline: NUMBER 10
segments.text: Number ten: eight. Game Awards nominations, the most of any game this year.

segments.headline: DECEMBER 10
segments.text: It's up for Game of the Year against five others, including a Zelda remake. Winners are announced December tenth.

chart.ticker: 007 First Light · Control Resonant · GTA VI · Phantom Blade Zero · Resident Evil Requiem · Ocarina of Time Remake

segments.headline: OUR TAKE
segments.text: Our take after week one: the big numbers aren't hype. The real open question now is frame rate.

segments.headline: YOUR TURN
segments.text: Which number surprised you most? Tell me in the comments, and subscribe: we break down GTA 6 every day.
